Celebrate the season with a lucky pot of gold. These things aren't cheap, so we had to pull some strings with the leprechauns to get them in the shop.

Hit the greens with the new "Lucky Hat". Will it improve your score card? Probably! I mean, just look at the size of that thing!

notes.title: The Purple Moon
notes.content:
The Purple moon is a rare phenomenon only seen from Planet Earth every few decades. Due to unknown factors, it has prematurely changed colors, and has yet to return to its natural state.

Scattered around the surface are objects that appear to be "Atomic Modifiers" that change the size of anything that comes in contact. Scientist are fearful of the long-term effects of the Moon's strange behaviors and have requested a special group of experts to visit the Moon as soon as possible. Individuals with mini-golf experience have been asked to join the mission.

More information about the Purple Moon will be provided as researchers gather images and video resources. Until then, please continue earning high scores as usual.

notes.title: Cross-Platform Multiplayer Now Available!
notes.content:
Boxel Golf can now be played on all of your favorite devices! If you've ever had the urge to play with your friends while using your work Mac, simply connect your Steam account to your Google Chrome extension and play until you clock out of work.

Cross-platform multiplayer allows you to connect with your friends anywhere in the world. Earn rewards together and compete in the ultimate golf experience!
